messages:
alex: heads-up — added a new 'Token Economics' panel to the prefix-cache observability dashboard. shows token-saved by model / route / customer. quick glance pls :eyes:
maya: nice, link? can you paste the queries so i can sanity-check the tenant grouping?
alex: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/7yA3/token-economics (view-only for now)
alex: query for token_savings timeseries (prometheus/grafana transform):
```
sum by (model, route, tenant_id) (increase(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total[1h]))
/ sum by (model, route, tenant_id) (increase(tokens_generated_total[1h]))
```
alex: then a derived panel computes absolute tokens saved:
```
sum by (model, route, tenant_id) (increase(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total[24h]))
```
jon: seeing weird spikes for model=rw-3.5-large on /completion route for a handful of tenants — time aligned with kernel rollout yesterday?
kate: yep — kernel-selector v2 switched preferred matmul kernel at 02:15 UTC and we also increased target_batch_size from 16 -> 24 in the autoscaler config. both could affect KV warmup timing and effective cache hit shape.
miguel: i pulled a flamegraph for the same window — batch queuing time went down but kv-cache lookup tail variance increased ~30ms for rw-3.5-large. attaching snippet in thread (short).
maya: that explains token-saved dip: if warm cache misses increase, we materialize more tokens. can we add a per-tenant 'cold-miss-rate' column?
alex: added a per-tenant table: cold_miss_rate = misses/(misses+hits) using the same window. also added a top-10 tenants saved waterfall (absolute tokens saved) so PMs can see impact.
jon: small UX ask — split the tenant list by customer segment (enterprise/saas/free) so sales can filter. we already have customer_tier label in the ingestion pipeline.
kate: action items: 1) rollback kernel-selector change on canary if cold_miss_rate > 2% for rw-3.5-large on canary hosts; 2) revert batch size bump for that model until we profile further; 3) alert rule: weekly token-saved drop >15% vs trailing-14d should page eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary/kernel-selector-v2 -> 6 hosts starting 2025-09-12T02:15Z (status: successful)
alex: noted. i'll pin the dashboard panels and add a short doc snippet in the board describing calculation assumptions (per-model normalization, tenant anonymization).
maya: thanks — i'll run a tenant-slice diff overnight and drop findings here. if someone can run a perf trace for rw-3.5-large with batch=16 vs 24 that'd be helpful (sam? jon?).
jon: i can run traces tomorrow morning. i'll attach kernel-level timings (matmul, softmax, kv-lookup) and a small table of token-saved deltas.
miguel: if we want to be fancy we can add a 'token-econ anomaly' ML alert that correlates kernel changes + batching + cache hit delta to produce a single severity score. low priority but useful.
alex: great thread. will follow up with PR for the dashboard config and the rollback playbook if the canary trips. :thumbsup:
